answer: Make every new identity lock a small stake that stays frozen until it earns passing grades in several separate epochs. A farm spinning up a thousand names must lock a thousand stakes and write a thousand distinct graded answers before any of them votes or earns, so cost grows per head while rewards do not. Jurors who approve planted junk forfeit their stake. Like a terrace orchard where each walnut tree needs seasons of watering before it bears, nobody can plant an instant oasis of fake trees overnight.
